# Amazon Bedrock document history — captured 2026-08-21
# Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/doc-history.html  (renders fine)

## *** AWS REVERSED LAST WEEK'S ENDPOINT GUIDANCE *** — read this before using the 08-14 cache.

### August 19, 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN
"Fixed Anthropic Messages API code samples and switched model-card OpenAI-SDK samples to
bedrock-runtime". Substance beneath the cosmetic title:
- Anthropic Messages API samples now target the **`bedrock-runtime` endpoint's `/anthropic` route**:
  `base_url="https://bedrock-runtime.{region}.amazonaws.com/anthropic"`, authenticated with a
  short-term bearer token from `aws-bedrock-token-generator`'s `provide_token()`.
  Applied to every Anthropic model card supporting bedrock-runtime (Opus 5, Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7,
  Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5, Fable 5) using the model's Global inference ID.
- **`OPENAI_BASE_URL` on 49 NON-Anthropic model cards** (OpenAI, Mistral, DeepSeek, Google, Meta,
  Qwen, MiniMax, NVIDIA, Moonshot AI, Z.AI, Writer, xAI) repointed from the `bedrock-mantle` `/v1`
  route to **`https://bedrock-runtime.{region}.amazonaws.com/openai/v1`**.
- Messages API tabs reordered to LEAD with bedrock-runtime; the `bedrock-mantle` curl tab moved last.
- mantle "continues to be fully supported"; mantle-ONLY pages still show mantle URLs:
  **Web Search, Projects, Workspaces, Chat Completions on mantle, the mantle Responses API**.
                                                            [reported 2026-08-21, HIGH/AIDR]

### August 15, 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN (two entries)
- "Updated endpoint guidance to recommend the bedrock-runtime endpoint" — across the whole User Guide,
  **recommending `bedrock-runtime` for new applications, INCLUDING for OpenAI- and
  Anthropic-compatible workloads.** This is the DIRECT REVERSAL of the guidance captured 2026-08-14
  (which recommended mantle for new applications). Retitled the Responses API and Chat Completions
  pages as the `bedrock-mantle` variants. Added cross-reference tips on the Projects and Workspaces
  pages. "Existing applications that use it do not need to change."
- Follow-up positioning: Quickstart tabs reordered (Messages, Responses, Chat Completions, Converse,
  Invoke); Messages tab uses the **`AnthropicBedrock` client with AWS SigV4** against bedrock-runtime;
  samples updated to Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol; a bedrock-runtime recommendation callout added to
  every supporting model card; **Daybreak Red: GPT-5.6 Cyber and Daybreak Blue: GPT-5.6 Sol added to
  the "Models at a glance" table**.
  => NOTE: auth differs BY ROUTE — bearer token on /anthropic per the Aug 19 entry, SigV4 via
     AnthropicBedrock per this one. Parser AND auth selection must key on the route path.

### August 14, 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN
- **AgentCore Memory integration for Bedrock agentic retrieval.** Agentic retrieval on fully managed
  Bedrock knowledge bases integrates with AgentCore Memory via a **`memoryConfiguration`** field on
  **`AgenticRetrieveStream`**. Three modes: restore an earlier session from short-term memory; let the
  agent retrieve records from long-term memory; or both.     [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM/AIDR]
  /kb-test-agentic-retrieve.html

### August 11, 2026 — reported 2026-08-14 (this is what surfaced Mantle)
IAM principal cost allocation extended to the `bedrock-mantle` endpoint.

### July 30, 2026
Amazon Bedrock Agents Classic no longer open to new customers.        [DEPRECATION — not reported]

## PROJECTS / WORKSPACES — new to this monitor, surfaced by the endpoint rewrite
Read from /workspaces.html. **Projects (OpenAI-compatible) and Workspaces (Anthropic-compatible) are
THE SAME UNDERLYING RESOURCE**, both managed through the **Projects API**.
  Create/List: POST|GET https://bedrock-mantle.{region}.api.aws/v1/organization/projects
  Returns: arn:aws:bedrock-mantle:{region}:{acct}:project/proj_...  , `id`, `name`, `status`,
           `created_at`, `object: organization.project`, `tags`
  Binding header:  Workspaces -> `anthropic-workspace: {project-id}`   (on /anthropic/v1/messages)
                   Projects    -> `OpenAI-Project: {project-id}`        (on /v1)
  Capabilities: access isolation (**project as a resource in IAM policies**), cost monitoring via
  AWS tags + Cost Explorer, per-workspace usage/observability. Lifecycle incl. **archiving**.
  **Every AWS account has a default workspace/project that all inference is associated with** unless
  another is named. AWS's recommended structure is one project per application per environment.
  => the project is asserted BY THE CALLER at request time via header, not derived from the
     credential — control-plane state alone won't tell you what traffic claimed.
  => naming collision: a Bedrock Workspace is NOT an Anthropic workspace; `anthropic-workspace` here
     carries an AWS `proj_` ID, not a `wrkspc_` ID.
                                                            [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM/AISPM]

Updated: 2026-08-21 — three new entries. The endpoint reversal supersedes the 2026-08-14 coverage
recommendation: the OpenAI/Anthropic wire formats must now be parsed on BOTH endpoints, selected by
ROUTE PATH rather than hostname.
